rule: D-LIB8M-TEMPO (lib4-cards.md section 16): the concentric phase takes up, the eccentric takes down; Hold takes pause right after the concentric, only if pause > 0; any other static phase is a constant only with a quote that states its seconds; a range is the quote's string. No Rest. The five no-seconds cards get no row until D-LIB14-NOSECS's release. Proposed in DESIGN.md section 8 (awaiting LB4 NOTE RULED).

rows.quote: The wall sit can be done for 2-5 sets of 30-60-second holds. If the athlete is able to hold for 60 seconds comfortably, variations to increase difficulty can be introduced, such as lifting one foot at a time, single-leg holds, or holding weight on the thighs.
